summary: MDA Space Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to report its first-quarter 2026 financial results. The press release discloses revenues of $464 million (+32% YoY), adjusted EBITDA of $91 million, net cash of $299 million, and a $3.7 billion backlog. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situations event is announced. The filing is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. earnings press release furnished under Form 6-K. The registrant is MDA Space Ltd., a Canadian company listed on TSX and NYSE. What to watch: continued execution on backlog and pipeline conversion; no special-situation involvement.
